question: On the closed-FRW V(phi)=0 component p_phi>0 and R=3*p_phi^2-2*P^2>0, does the prior on-shell relational coordinate extend through C=c to one exact classical componentwise off-shell Darboux chart (T,c,Phi,p_phi) generated by W(c,P,p_phi)=-integral_0^P Q(c,u,p_phi) du?

repository_sources.role: the immediately prior valid result whose on-shell Phi_star, endpoint action, finite flow and local FP reduction must be recovered rather than overwritten
the reviewed separation of raw-static, HTV improved-static, relational and auxiliary mixed-polarization action ledgers
Lorentzian closed-FRW constraint, lapse-sign and endpoint convention
proper-time BFV endpoint conditions and ghost/modulus boundary that remain outside the classical chart
zero-lapse distributional and reduced-BFV boundary that is not inferred from a Darboux coordinate change
endpoint-polarization and full BFV super-Hessian boundary

primary_sources.source: Henneaux, Teitelboim and Vergara, Gauge invariance for generally covariant systems, Nucl. Phys. B 387 (1992) 391, arXiv:hep-th/9205092
primary_sources.used_for: the classical endpoint-improvement and canonical-gauge framework, including the need to transform endpoint data consistently
primary_sources.not_used_for: claiming that the repository mixed generating function is already a normalized quantum endpoint-state transform or a complete BFV path integral

primary_sources.source: Banihashemi and Jacobson, On the lapse contour, Phys. Rev. D 111, 066014 (2025), arXiv:2405.10307
primary_sources.used_for: the reduced-phase-space versus configuration-space and lapse-contour boundary, and the local trace-momentum gauge premise
primary_sources.not_used_for: deriving this closed-FRW Darboux chart, endpoint-state kernel, source deformation or full lapse-contour interchange

primary_sources.source: Marolf, Path integrals and instantons in quantum gravity: Minisuperspace models, Phys. Rev. D 53 (1996) 6979, arXiv:gr-qc/9602019
primary_sources.used_for: the full-real-lapse distributional physical-inner-product kernel as a still-uncomputed comparison target
primary_sources.not_used_for: promoting a classical local symplectomorphism to the quantum kernel or calling delta(C) an ordinary bounded idempotent projector on continuous zero spectrum

model.phase_space: Q=2*log(a), P=a*p_a/2, phi, p with {Q,P}={phi,p}=1 and a=exp(Q/2)>0
model.component: U_plus={(Q,P,phi,p): p>0 and R=3*p^2-2*P^2>0}; the straight segment u from 0 to P remains in R(u,p)>0
model.implicit_positive_root: A(c,P,p)>0 is the unique positive root of F=72*pi^4*A^4+12*pi^2*c*A^3-R=0, and Q(c,P,p)=2*log(A)
model.trace_fp: D=-C_Q=(R+24*pi^4*a^4)/(8*pi^2*a^3)=3*c/2+12*pi^2*A on C=c, hence D>0 on U_plus
model.boundary_potential: B=P*Q+W-c*T-p*W_p, so P*dQ+p*dphi=c*dT+p*dPhi+dB and the classical transformed action is S_D=S0-[B]

exact_plan.positive_root_existence: F(0)=-R<0 and F(A) tends to positive infinity
exact_plan.positive_root_uniqueness: for c>=0 F is strictly increasing; for c<0 its only positive turning point is A_t=-c/(8*pi^2) and F(A_t)=-(512*pi^4*R+3*c^4)/(512*pi^4)<0, so exactly one later positive root exists
exact_plan.implicit_derivatives: Q_c=-1/D, Q_P=C_P/D and Q_p=C_p/D on C(Q,P,p)=c
exact_plan.generator_derivatives: W_P=-Q, T_P=1/D and Phi_P=-C_p/D at fixed (c,p)
exact_plan.canonical_brackets: {T,c}=1, {Phi,p}=1 and every mixed bracket vanishes after using T_p=Phi_c=W_cp
exact_plan.inverse_chart: T_P=1/D>0 makes P locally and componentwise monotonically invertible at fixed (c,p)
exact_plan.on_shell_recovery: at c=0, Q=log(R/(72*pi^4))/2, Phi=phi-sqrt(3/2)*atanh(sqrt(2/3)*P/p), and the normalized boundary potential B with B(P=0)=0 reduces to B=P
exact_plan.endpoint_variation: subtracting [B] gives endpoint variation [c*dT+p*dPhi] and recovers S0-[P] when c=0; B=-F only on the prior P-to-zero shell-flow ledger and is not the HTV improved-static action
exact_plan.gauge_and_measure: P=0 maps to T=0; delta(P-f)*D becomes delta(T-T_f) on D>0, leaving dPhi*dp after delta(c)

decision_table.condition: all exact domain, implicit-root, generating-function, Liouville, canonical-matrix, inverse-chart, on-shell-recovery and numerical root-control checks pass
decision_table.meaning: Keep the exact classical Darboux chart on U_plus and its c=0 recovery; do not infer a quantum endpoint-state transform, BFV source, delta(C) kernel, global gauge or physical cycle.

decision_table.condition: the domain and canonical chart checks pass but the declared c=0 Phi_star, B=P or FP-measure recovery fails
decision_table.meaning: Keep only the independently established classical chart while rejecting the claimed connection to the prior on-shell endpoint result.

decision_table.condition: positive-root uniqueness or D positivity fails on the declared frozen component
decision_table.meaning: Reject the off-shell chart route on U_plus while leaving unrelated Gate-1 routes unchanged.

decision_table.condition: the R>0 domain and unique positive root remain regular but a generating-function, Liouville, endpoint-variation or canonical-bracket identity fails
decision_table.meaning: Reject this off-shell extension without rewriting the previously supported on-shell relational endpoint result.

decision_table.condition: all exact domain, canonical-chart and on-shell-recovery checks pass but the independent numerical root control fails
decision_table.meaning: Leave the off-shell extension unpromoted and create no automatic diagnostic successor.

computed_scope: the classical closed-FRW V=0 open component U_plus with p>0 and R>0 across arbitrary real constraint values c
the unique positive implicit scale-factor root and positive trace FP bracket on that component
one mixed generating function and its exact componentwise Darboux coordinates
the exact Liouville one-form boundary potential, canonical Poisson matrix and unit Jacobian
the classical transformed action S0-[B] and its fixed-(T,Phi) endpoint variation
the c=0 recovery of the prior Q_star and Phi_star
the classical local gauge/measure coordinate identity and independent high-precision root sanity checks
not_computed: a chart on p<=0, R<=0, another connected component or all closed-FRW phase space
a normalized quantum endpoint-state integral transform, its measure, phase, domain or unitarity
ghost, antighost and multiplier endpoint conditions, a BFV gauge fermion or replacement BFV source
equality with the old fixed-(a,phi) constant-lapse kernel
the full-real-lapse distributional delta(C) physical-inner-product kernel or regulator removal
zero-lapse extension, global orbit coverage, Gribov-copy census, determinant-line orientation or physical original cycle
